company.name: Lendo
company.shortDescription: Lendo is an alternative lending marketplace that helps digitally finance small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Saudi Arabia.
company.description:
Lendo is an alternative lending marketplace that helps digitally finance small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Saudi Arabia.
Lendo was granted the first Crowdlending (debt financing) licensed in Saudi Arabia, and received the Excellence in Finance Leaders Award from FiNext Awards.
Lendo’s products and solutions make everyday business activities easier, more secure, and more efficient for both investors and borrowers alike.

productsAndServices.description: A service that provides immediate cash liquidity to SMEs by financing their accounts receivable invoices.

productsAndServices.description: Investment options for individuals to invest in short-term financing opportunities for SMEs, with returns based on credit risk assessments.
productsAndServices.name: Short-term Investment Opportunities

productsAndServices.description: An automated investment tool that manages and diversifies investor portfolios across available financing opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Auto-Invest Feature

productsAndServices.description: A credit evaluation system that uses multiple data points and integrations with Saudi credit bureaus to assess the risk of financing opportunities.
productsAndServices.name: Credit Risk Assessment and Scoring

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $49,988,309, or 6.45% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,990,733 to $147,690,156, a 10.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
